progression.title: My progress
progression.intro: Everything the garden remembers about your reading stays in this browser. Export it to keep a copy or to pick up on another device.
progression.empty: Nothing saved in this browser yet.
progression.noStorage: Local storage is blocked in this browser (private mode?): nothing to export or import here.
progression.privacy: Nothing goes through the server: export, import and link all happen in this browser.
progression.exportText: A dated JSON file, to keep or to import elsewhere.
progression.importText: A file exported from this site. Nothing changes until you confirm.
progression.linkText: All your progress, compressed into the address itself (after the #, which is never sent to the server). Open it on the other device.
progression.linkShown: Couldn’t copy: select the link below.
progression.linkTooBig: Too much data for a link ({n} characters, {max} at most): use the file instead.
progression.linkUnsupported: This browser can’t compress the data: use the file.
progression.fromLink: Progress received by link, exported on {date}.
progression.modeMergeHint: keeps everything; for the same item, the most recent version wins
progression.modeReplaceHint: erases this browser’s progress and puts the file’s in its place
progression.noChange: Nothing would change: this browser already has it all.
progression.dropped: {n} unknown or damaged entries will be skipped.
progression.doneError: Incomplete import: the browser’s storage is full or blocked.
progression.errFormat: This isn’t a garden progress file.
progression.errVersion: This file comes from a newer version of the site: reload the page and try again.
progression.errEmpty: The file holds no usable progress.
progression.errLink: This transfer link is incomplete or damaged.
